text.tspan: Grant for BK-7KQ2M9: Meeting Room A (space_id 1), code H7K3-9QXA, window [2026-10-07 09:00, 10:30)
Each scan below is a POST with code only. The room comes from access_session.
A space_id sent with a code is ignored, so a cross-site form cannot pick the room (AXS-R11)
Every scan: normalise (upper-case, strip spaces and hyphens, AXS-R12),
then decide in order unknown_code, revoked, wrong_room, window (AXS-R14, AXS-R13)
The lock is mocked: ok and checked_in never prove a door opened (ADR-0017)
normalised BK7KQ2M9, no ticket code starts with BK (AXS-R06, AXS-R08)

g.text: [09:10, Staff moves the kiosk to room 2 (Focus Pod 1)]
[09:10, room 1, code of a cancelled booking (grant revoked)]
[09:10, room 1, booking reference BK-7KQ2M9 typed in]
[09:10, no room in access_session (new browser, or a cross-site form)]

text.tspan: Access never calls Purchase or Payment. Purchase sent the window at issuance (AXS-R04, PUR-R27)

svg.text: 200 room list from space_id and space_name in stored grants, autofocused code input (AXS-R11)
POST /checkin space_id=1 (no code: select Meeting Room A)
303 to /checkin, room 1 stored in the access_session cookie (AXS-R11, AXS-R18)
store scan ok, grant issued to checked_in (first ok scan, AXS-R16)
303 to /checkin, data-result="ok" (re-entry inside the window, AXS-R13)
303 to /checkin, data-result="closed" "Check-in closed at 10:30" (end is exclusive)
POST /checkin space_id=2 (no code: select Focus Pod 1)
303 to /checkin, data-result="wrong_room" "This ticket is for Meeting Room A"
303 to /checkin, flash "Select the room first", no scan stored (AXS-R11)
200 last 10 scans at room 1, newest first, masked ••••-9QXA (AXS-R15)
